preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 5000 for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip() else [] for x in line.split())
preconditions.description: All matrix entries (Bi,j) and query values (Fi) are integers in the range [0, 5000].

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) >= 2 and all(len(line.split()) == int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: The input matrix is N×N, where N is the first integer in the first line.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(p) <= int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] if '0' <= line[0] <= '9')
preconditions.description: Each query's row/column index p is within the valid range [1, N].

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] if '0' <= line[0] <= '9' and line.strip() != '')
preconditions.description: Each query's new row/column values have exactly N entries.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N integers, matching the sequence length.

postconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= int(x) <= 5000 or -5000 <= int(x) <= -1 for x in line.split()) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output sequence contains integers in the range [-5000, 5000], allowing for negative values.

postconditions.expression: all(all(abs(int(Ai) - int(Aj)) == int(Bi_j) for Ai, Aj in zip(line.split(), line.split()) for Bi_j in [stdin.splitlines()[i+1].split()[j] for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0])) for j in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0])) if (i == 0 and j == 1) or (i == 1 and j == 0)]) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: For each output sequence A, the matrix B derived from A (where Bi,j = |Ai - Aj|) matches the current matrix B (accounting for query updates).

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(Ai) <= int(Aj) or (int(Ai) == int(Aj) and i < j) for i, Ai in enumerate(line.split()) for j, Aj in enumerate(line.split()) if i < j) for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each output sequence is lexicographically smallest among all valid sequences.

postconditions.expression: all(all(int(A1) == 0 for line in stdout.splitlines()) if int(stdin.splitlines()[0].split()[0]) >= 1 else True)
postconditions.description: The first element of each output sequence is always 0 (A1 = 0).
